In addition, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), learning and performance consultants, developers, deployment teams, and vendors.

Draft learning objectives that meet EY quality standards Apply effective learning strategies and design guidelines to ensure the creation of impactful learning materials. Assist in drafting Learning Solution Plans and contribute to the continuous improvement of learning solutions. Utilize rapid authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, and Articulate Studio to create engaging and interactive learning modules. Excellent English written and verbal communication skills; ability to write effective instructional text, and facilitator materials.  What you need to qualify for the role 
 3 to 6 years of experience in designing courses and other learning items. Experience in designing effective learning solutions for eLearning, Physical Classroom, and Virtual Classrooms. Required experience in storyboarding courses and simulations using: Articulate Rise Storyline 360 MS Word, PowerPoint, and whiteboarding applications (ie Miro/Mural/MS Whiteboard) Additional experience in storyboarding for Videos iPDFs/Flipbooks Experience in writing assessments aligned to learning objectives Experience in applying accessibility standards and offering direction to address gaps 
 
 What we look for 
 An experienced instructional designer who can support multiple projects concurrently. A professional who can quickly problem-solve and can offer perspective on solutions. A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions and valuing diverse perspectives. Experience in applying the US CPE requirements Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients. Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.
